verdict.rationale: An audit trail is a fair axis for accounting/ledger software, but the evidence pack never documents an audit log recording who changed what and when across the ledger. The closest item is that editing a manual journal entry creates a reversing entry plus a new one. That is an adjacent history-preserving behavior, not a user-attributed, ledger-wide change log, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
